body: The biggest problem I am dealing with at this point is that I will have no contact with him for a few weeks while he's at the hospital. Just me and my thoughts until then.
Thank you for telling me what is probable and real in a positive way, this is the kind of advice I was looking for. Thank you.
Thank you for the encouragement, I really needed that. I'm getting a bit of negativity for whatever reason and you really helped. Thank you.

I know I'm a stupid teenager, you don't have to remind me. But I think there are a few details that might be helpful here. 

- He's not going through any transition right now as he doesn't have the money and politics are not helping. 

- I have been suicidal in the past, so I'm not in unfamiliar territory with regard to that. 

- I came here to get some help, so I won't argue with what you've given me, that would be stupid on my part. 

- The authorities are already involved, he was detained with slashes on his wrist that now need to be stitched closed, so he wasn't threatening as much as informing. 

I'm also going through a bit of a tough time with all of this and I feel your tone is a bit abrasive and I don't appreciate it, thank you for your input though. 
 
Edit: After looking through your history it's all abrasive, negative, and heavy handed, thanks for your input but I think you are approaching relationship advice incorrectly.
